programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: The House of Mirth
programme.desc: Lily (Gillian Anderson) is a ravishing socialite who quickly discovers the precariousness of her position when her beauty and charm start attracting unwelcome interest and jealousy. She seeks a wealthy husband and, in trying to conform to social expectations, she misses her chance for real love with Lawrence Selden (Eric Stoltz). Her quest for a husband comes to a scandalous end when she is falsely accused of having an affair with a married man and is rejected by society and her friends. - Gillian Anderson, Eric Stoltz, Dan Aykroyd, Eleanor Bron, Terry Kinney (Historical drama)

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. - Matt Bomer, Josh Wiggins, Bill Pullman, Alex Neustaedter, Lily Gladstone (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: Smoke Signals
programme.desc: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. - Adam Beach, Evan Adams, Irene Bedard, Gary Farmer, Tantoo Cardinal (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright). - Tom Hanks, Robin Wright, Gary Sinise, Mykelti Williamson, Sally Field (Comedy drama, Romance, Adventure, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement. (Documentary, Music)

When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately, but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey. - Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, GQ, James Bulliard (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.desc: S1E5 - Even with Ashley, Ryan and Jedi to help, Chase and family have a ton of work to do to turn their walkout basement into a family room complete with a new bathroom; only Chase could find a second life for old animal troughs. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Exteriors and The Final Reveal
programme.desc: S1E6 - With two weeks left and a ton of work remaining, including exteriors, roofing, decking, landscaping and a missing bedroom, Chase, Ashley, Ryan, Sarah and the kids have to rally to finish the house. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Cabin Masters to the Rescue
programme.desc: S5E2 - Gary and his wife Ellen inherited 97 acres of pristine land in the lush woods of Manchester Maine; ultimate dream for Gary and Ellen is to see a cabin finished so they can enjoy it with their three grown children and four grandchildren. - Jared Baker, Matthew Dix, Ashley Morrill, Ryan Eldridge, Brad Weston (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - The Morrill Family Bunkhouse
programme.desc: S2E8 - Chase and his team restore the old army barracks, which have provided overflow sleeping accommodations for more than 40 years at the Morrill family camp; the guys strive to save the structure for their growing family and future family reunions. - Ashley Morrill, Matthew Dix, Ryan Eldridge, Jared Baker, Lance Gatcomb (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Ballard
programme.desc: S4E8 - An early 1900s cabin that's intimately tied to Maine's history and legacy puts the team to the test as they try to re-create its original look and feel. - Ashley Morrill, Matthew Dix, Jared Baker, Ryan Eldridge, Brad Weston (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Lobster Legacy Shack
programme.desc: S4E2 - A couple inherit a quaint cabin; Chase and his team focus on transforming the former fish and lobster shack into a fun family cabin. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Roberts
programme.desc: S4E13 - A man and his fiancé would like to see their rustic camping cabin without plumbing transformed into a place they can entertain, use the bathroom indoors and enjoy multiple seasons; they'd also like to pay homage to their funeral home business. - Ashley Morrill, Matthew Dix, Jared Baker, Ryan Eldridge (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - The Twister Camp
programme.desc: S3E10 - A couple calls on Chase and his team to help save their mountain camp which was leveled by a tornado; with an emphasis on outdoor entertaining, the team adds an open second floor while racing to wrap it up before the first snow falls. programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Free Will House

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Rural Retreat Historical Society
programme.desc: S6E7 - Mike, Robert and the team travel to the Rural Retreat Historical Society in Rural Retreat, Va.; Mike sets up rigging from the rooftop for an outdoor clock, while Robert salvages a vault door and a bank teller station. Tay and Mike build a day bed. (Reality, Home improvement)

programme.title: Barnwood Builders - Just in Time
programme.desc: S10E9 - Mark finds a Pennsylvania barn that's being torn down and buys it then and there; Johnny deals with overhead wires, Sherman works with one good arm, and Tim never stops running. (Reality, How-to, Home improvement, Documentary)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - An Upstate New York Family Seeks Lakeside Sanctuary in the Finger Lakes
programme.desc: S5E8 - An upstate New York couple is taking the leap in the Finger Lakes region; with their young daughter and son in tow and relatives nearby, they're excited to transform a charming fixer-upper into a place for lasting family memories. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A New Start for Two Retirees on Michigan's Duck Lake
programme.desc: S6E2 - A retired military couple wants to move from Maryland to find a forever home n Michigan's Duck Lake. They're willing to put in some sweat equity for renovations with hopes they can inspire their children and grandchildren to make frequent visits. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Tonight (Live)
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster of hosts, former players and inside information men. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. - Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash, Adam Rodriguez (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Yûki Kudô, Max Von Sydow (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. - Marlon Wayans, Essence Atkins, Cedric the Entertainer, David Koechner, Nick Swardson (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. - Marlon Wayans, Jaime Pressly, Essence Atkins, Gabriel Iglesias, Cedric the Entertainer (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. - Matt Bomer, Josh Wiggins, Bill Pullman, Alex Neustaedter, Lily Gladstone (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. - Dave Johns, Hayley Squires, Dylan McKiernan, Briana Shann, Kate Rutter (Drama)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. - Ian McKellen, Laura Linney, Milo Parker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Hattie Morahan (Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies. - Demetri Martin, Kevin Kline, Gillian Jacobs, Rory Scovel, Christine Woods (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand, Paul Giamatti, Catherine Zeta-Jones (Musical)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, Kevin Bacon, Nathan Fillion (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career. (Documentary, Comedy)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. - Jon Hamm, Kyle MacLachlan, Marcia Gay Harden, Roy Wood Jr., Annie Mumolo (Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Prison Fighters: 5 Rounds to Freedom
programme.desc: An examination of a practice in Thailand's criminal justice system, where inmates are given the opportunity to earn their freedom through Muay Thai fighting. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber, Ross Brodar, Josh Charles (Drama)

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye. - Nicholas Hoult, Kevin Spacey, Sarah Paulson, Hope Davis, Victor Garber (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. - Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Mike Vogel, Nate Torrence (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. - Henry Golding, Beatrice Grannò, Aura Garrido, Rubén Ochandiano, Nathalie Poza (Science fiction, Romance)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. programme.desc: Adventures filmed in many of the best fishing and hunting destinations in North America. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Waterfowl East - Blown Roost
programme.desc: S3E3 - The roost gets pushed off early morning, but being on the X the geese find their way back to the feed, along with a welcome bunch of ducks. (Hunting)

programme.title: 704 Outdoors - Free Range Nilgai in Texas - Part 1
programme.desc: Beth and John head to Southern Texas in search of free-range Nilgai. Beth is first up and makes it count! (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Hunt Warz - Illinois Archery Whitetail Deer Matchup: 3 of 3
programme.desc: In the 3rd episode of the archery whitetail hunt series in Illinois, the excitement reaches new heights; the second buck shot is found, and the competition is fiercer than ever. (Hunting)

programme.title: Sporting Classics With Chris Dorsey - Lowcountry Magic
programme.desc: Chris Dorsey and guests go on a hunt for quail, hog and redfish at Brays Island Plantation in South Carolina. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Viejo Creek Outdoors - Ladies Day at the Creek
programme.desc: S1E3 - It's Girl Power at Viejo Creek Ranch as Avery Simpson and Tara Stewart hunt for whitetail. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures - Laura and Zac Gidney Part 2 of 2
programme.desc: S7E2 - At 18, Zac Gidney already has a deep understanding of trapping and animal behavior-knowledge well beyond his years; his mother, Laura, is every bit as skilled; joining this talented duo on their New York trapline as they put their experience to work. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.tv Fishing Edition - Ecuador - Part 3
programme.desc: S1E3 - After several missed opportunities, Mario and David double their efforts to finally land their arapaima. (Fishing)

programme.title: Deertopia - Small Acreage, Big Yields
programme.desc: This episode proves that small-property managers can achieve massive habitat success with the right strategy. The team shares expert tips on creating year-round food sources using native fruits and Dunston Chestnuts. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Choice - We bowhunted the Kansas Whitetail!
programme.desc: Ralph and Vicki head to Kansas with J and M Whitetails once again for a week of archery hunting in prime whitetail country! Sharing camp and chasing mature bucks together, just like they have for the past 30+ years, everything feels right. (Hunting)

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv - TT29 E15 Aim True Academy
programme.desc: A: Point Blank Zero B: When The Dot Fails/KDG Sectional Rail C: Single Action Safety D: Types of Bedding. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy - Appalachian Slam: Buck, Bear & Boar in the Mountain State
programme.desc: S13E5 - From dawn to dusk, B.T. battles brutal terrain and unpredictable weather while employing different hunting strategies for each species in this action-packed mountain adventure. (Outdoors, Hunting, Reality)

programme.title: Claudio Ongaro's Hired to Hunt - The Perfect Hunt
programme.desc: S9E3 - On this hunt, Daryl guides five clients and Claudio to 48 ducks and 48 geese to wrap up the perfect trip. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Fishing the Wild West - Serengeti Fishing Charters
programme.desc: S10E3 - Wes trolls for salmon and jigs for halibut with Serengeti Fishing Charters. (Fishing)

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony - Dem Does (New)
programme.desc: Blaine finishes up his blackbuck hunt in Texas then goes after Camp meat. We are officially on doe patrol. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal TV - Devil Rapids Walleyes
programme.desc: S8E11 - Knobby's Fly-In and Outpost does it again - unreal fishing! (Outdoors)

programme.title: Passion For The Hunt - December Pheasant Hunting in South Dakota
programme.desc: Late-season pheasant hunt South of Watertown, South Dakota; hunting with Sioux River Hunt Club. (Outdoors)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Chasing Alberta Bulls
programme.desc: Zack Brown and Louie DeBrusk are racing the clock in pursuit of one of North America's most elusive giants, the bull elk; head deep into prime elk country with limited time, tight windows of opportunity and high expectations. (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Mellon Patch, It's a Family Thing - Time to Hatch Chicks
programme.desc: S2E2 - Rich and Sandi start the process of segregating birds and collecting eggs to load the incubator for the first hatch of the season.

programme.title: Red Arrow - No Country for Old Mulies
programme.desc: Kip heads west with high hopes of an action-packed couple of spot and stalk bow hunts; but what he finds is a less than ideal situation to say the least; you're not going to believe what the Red Arrow crew has to deal with on this trip. (Hunting)

programme.title: 72 Hours to Survive - Canoe Survival
programme.desc: S1E4 - Dale heads out for a solo canoe trip on Lesser Salve Lake. The episode begins with the canoe tipping over into the water. Dale loses all his gear and food. Dale must use only what he had in his PFD and pockets for 72 hours until rescue. (Adventure)

programme.title: Deer & Deer Hunting - Science of Death
programme.desc: S22E3 - This week we dive into whitetail anatomy to explain the science behind a humane harvest. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.TV - Dindon sauvage de l'Ontario
programme.desc: S4E6 - The team continues their wild turkey hunt in Ontario. After taking two birds the day before, they still have two more tags to fill. (Nature, Adventure)

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV - Hook's Revenge
programme.desc: S1E3 - The crew heads back to Costa Rica, to settle the score with the year before when we got robbed of more than just big fish; this time we are determined to bring in some records! (Hunting)

programme.title: Beyond the Blind Hunts - Rookie Roosters
programme.desc: S1E3 - Justin heads to Alberta's Wessex Game Birds for his first-ever pheasant hunt. With fast-flying birds, missed opportunities, and lessons learned in the field, every flush is a chance to become a better hunter. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Way It Was Tv - Christian Turner: The Razorback Grandson (New)
programme.desc: The guys sit down with Christian Bud Turner, Lynn Beaty's grandson and an Arkansas Razorback baseball player. Bud talks about his path to college baseball, life as a Razorback, hunting stories and some of the lessons he's learned along the way. (Hunting)

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv - TT29 E16 Shooting Edge (New)
programme.desc: A: Zeroing 45° B: Functional Exercises/KDG Sidelock C: High Standard 380 D: Shooting Bags. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Mitchell Payment's Moment of Truth TV - Spring Blizzards (New)
programme.desc: S10E3 - Mitchell and friends head to the flyway for spring snow geese. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation - Secrets of Africa
programme.desc: S4E10 - In Namibia, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area. (Docudrama, Science, Nature, Animals, Documentary)

programme.title: Long Range Hunter - Epic Hunt in South Africa - Part 3
programme.desc: S6E3 - This week, the conclusion of the epic hunting trip at Lakeside Safari in South Africa. (Hunting)

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors With Tim Sylvia - Chasin Big Bucks
programme.desc: This week we have Grant Boies and Dave Hendrickson on their search for big whitetail. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Reel West Coast - Tofino Squid Fishing
programme.desc: S9E2 - Brendan heads out of Tofino to chase his newest obsession; jigging for squid and then using them as bait for salmon battles. - Brendan Morrison (Fishing, Adventure, Travel)

programme.title: Trapping Inc. - Squirrel Apocalypse
programme.desc: S12E3 - Rich and Sandi continue to expand the marten line while dealing with weather, frost and a surprising population explosion. (Hunting)

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV - Hook's Revenge
programme.desc: S1E3 - The crew heads back to Costa Rica, to settle the score with the year before when we got robbed of more than just big fish; this time we are determined to bring in some records! (Hunting)

programme.title: Elusive Wildlife - Vanishing Bucks
programme.desc: S1E2 - Summer cameras were loaded with giant Texas whitetails until the acorns started falling; as opening day nears, the bucks vanish without a trace, forcing Chad and Scott to figure out whether the deer moved out or simply changed patterns. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Outdoor Quest - Free-Range Kudu in the Eastern Cape
programme.desc: TJ takes it right to the last day in his search for a monster free-range kudu in the Eastern Cape of South Africa. (Fishing, Hunting)

programme.title: Aventures Express.tv Fishing Edition - Ecuador - Part 3
programme.desc: S1E3 - After several missed opportunities, Mario and David double their efforts to finally land their arapaima. (Fishing)

programme.title: Forever Wild Outdoors Adrenaline Adventures - 2025 Deerassic Youth Turkey Hunt - Part 2
programme.desc: S12E2 - From exciting encounters and changing game plans to lessons in sportsmanship and perseverance, this hunt showcases the traditions and values that help keep our hunting heritage alive. (Outdoors)

programme.title: High BC - Edge of Smoke
programme.desc: S3E2 - Join us for an intense alpine mule deer adventure in British Columbia as we hike deep into rugged country carrying heavy packs, limited water, and high expectations. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Dirt Nap TV - It's Go Time - Africa Part 2 of 7
programme.desc: S6E2 - Bowhunting mountain reed buck by day and bush pigs by night. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Big Tracks & Heavy Racks Marathon - Big Tracks & Heavy Racks Marathon 2026
